name: De Vinne 10pt 1897
designer: Unidentified in the retained source pages
foundry: Shown by the United States Government Printing Office; 1897 stock mark Keystone–10
description: Ten-point De Vinne with flared serifs, a sweeping Q tail, double-storey a and g, and observed mixed-height figures. Eight named alternates retain source variations.
character_set_notes: Complete observed A–Z, a–z and ten figures, with period, comma, em dash and the double-bar historical hyphen encoded as hyphen-minus. Space has a modern layout advance. Eight observed alternatives are unencoded glyphs available through stylistic sets; no unsupported character is inferred. 8 whole observed diagonal fractions, cent and percent are also encoded. Fraction row-center placement is a modern layout convention, independent of historical baseline evidence. Source-quality gaps: U+215E; these companions remain unencoded. The matching poster specimens supply the observed colon, semicolon and right single quotation mark used as an apostrophe; no ASCII apostrophe or opening quotation mark is inferred.
observed: The 1897 specimen supplies both complete ten-point alphabets. Matching census, job-room and document impressions supply clearer letters, all ten figures and punctuation. The census M, four 1897 figures, tall document zero and baseline job-room seven are retained as named alternatives. The census ten-figure row is the default set with a clearer matching job-room four; unequal source positions are preserved. Matching ATF assortments supply whole 10-point diagonal fractions and symbols; exact selected pages, crops, thresholds and scale measurements are retained. A broad, flatter S appears beside a narrow S in the Handy ten-point MUSCLES setting. The complete matching poster broad impression is retained as an unencoded alternate. Matching ATF poster specimens supply the whole colon, semicolon and right single quotation mark used as an apostrophe at measured capital scale and native text-row baselines.
reconstructed: No visible form is invented. Uniform source-page scaling, measured rigid baseline rotation, local paper correction and modern spacing prepare the observed forms. No cross-size substitution or independent width stretching. Fraction row-center placement at 350 is a modern layout choice; no historical text baseline is established by the charts. No fraction parts are assembled or redrawn.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: All visible forms are observed. Four-times Lanczos source sampling preserves small serifs during curve fitting;73 exact derived crops retain native JP2 coordinates and hashes. Uniform page scales and measured row/numeral baseline rotations preserve optical proportions. Eight named alternatives use ss01/ss02/ss03/ss04; ss04 selects the broad S. No holes are filled and no visible form is drawn. See source/METHOD.md. The whole fraction companions retain their full physical source dimensions and deliberate slash interruptions. Existing outlines, spacing and named alternatives are preserved. Whole punctuation companions retain observed row-relative positions, independently measured scale and modern 35-unit sidebearings. Exact evidence and quality limits are recorded in source/punctuation-review.json.
